purpose: Backtest provisional v0.1 thresholds on crisis and false-positive control windows before threshold calibration.

episodes.label: dot-com stress
episodes.event_anchor_definition: NBER recession start / broad macro stress
episodes.notes: Pre-2003 inflation-expectation and Fed-futures series require compatibility proxies; do not use this event for precise production threshold optimization.

episodes.label: global financial crisis
episodes.notes: Inflation expectation crossed 2.5% in early 2008; credit and volatility stress subsequently confirmed.

episodes.label: COVID financial shock
episodes.event_anchor_definition: S&P 500 bear-market low / acute market stress
episodes.notes: This is a non-inflationary stress control. It tests whether the framework can detect credit/market stress without Energy→Inflation confirmation.

episodes.label: inflation/rates shock
episodes.event_anchor_definition: S&P 500 2022 bear-market low / peak tightening stress
episodes.notes: HY OAS exceeded 400bp by early March; 5Y5Y was above 2.5% in April; VIX exceeded 25 repeatedly.

episodes.label: US downgrade / Euro-area debt stress
episodes.event_anchor_definition: acute risk-off episode without US systemic banking failure
episodes.notes: HY spread was around 604bp, VIX was elevated, oil was >$90, and 5Y5Y inflation expectations were >2.5%; simple convergence logic can therefore fire.

episodes.label: Q4 2018 tightening selloff
episodes.event_anchor_definition: equity drawdown / tightening stress without broad credit crisis
episodes.notes: Credit and VIX stress occurred, but Energy/Inflation/Policy convergence was insufficient for L2 under v0.1.

interpretation.headline: v0.1 detects all four selected target stress episodes but produces a material false positive in 2011.
interpretation.main_failure_mode: Inflation/energy/credit/volatility can converge during non-systemic risk-off episodes even when the policy/rates transmission leg is absent.
interpretation.calibration_direction: For inflationary convergence, require policy/rates confirmation in addition to credit. Keep a separate financial-shock leg for Credit+VIX+NFCI so COVID-type systemic liquidity shocks remain detectable.
